content:
jen.k: Hey payroll  got my April salary and a relocation lump sum today but net is way lower than expected. Payslip shows 24% backup withholding + Swiss source tax and social contributions. I moved to Zurich Feb 2 and submitted the Swiss tax reg on Feb 1.
dan.pay: Ouch. Can you paste the redacted payslip lines?
jen.k: pasted snippet below (redacted acct ids)
```
Gross relocation lump sum: CHF 10,000
Backup withholding (US backup): 24% = CHF 2,400
Swiss source tax (ZH): 10% = CHF 1,000
AHV/IV/ALV (social): 6.5% = CHF 650
Net shown for lump sum: CHF 5,950
Total net pay on slip: CHF 6,120
```
emily.tax: quick context  US backup withholding is usually applied if W-9 not on file or TIN invalid. Strange that both were applied after you submitted Swiss docs.
dan.pay: I see you recently changed employee record to International; internal notes show two payroll feeds: US-RETRO and CH-ONBOARD. Looks like the US feed flagged the lump sum before the CH run removed it, and backup withholding triggered because the US tax status field was still empty in our payroll system at cutoff.
jen.k: I definitely uploaded a filled W-9 during onboarding and DM'd People Ops with Swiss AHV ref.
people-ops: we have your uploads. Will forward to payroll to reconcile timestamps.
dan.pay: Opening ticket now 4dd https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PR-5301 - "Relocation lump sum double withhold / backup withholding applied" - assigning to dan.pay. payroll-bot: PR-5301 created by dan.pay  status: Open.
dan.pay: Jen, can you DM me the timestamped upload screenshots for both W-9 and Swiss tax reg? Need to attach to PR.
jen.k: sent DM with both PDFs and upload confirmation emails.
dan.pay: investigation: root cause = dual-feed overlap + missing US tax residency flag at payroll cutoff (manual field that didn't sync via HRIS). Remediation plan: 1) void duplicate US withholding via off-cycle credit 2) adjust social contributions if incorrectly charged 3) issue corrected payslip and letter for tax filing. Off-cycle payment scheduled for 2026-04-07 if banking clears.
emily.tax: for your US tax position, we'll provide a statement to claim credit for Swiss taxes on your 2026 US return if needed. Also check whether backup withholding can be reclaimed; usually can once TIN proof is provided.
dan.pay: payroll-bot: PR-5301 update: investigation complete  remediation planned  off-cycle credit scheduled 1746100000.
jen.k: thanks  any action I need to take?
emily.tax: please keep copies of the corrected payslip and the off-cycle remittance. We may request signed authorization for reversing withholdings in certain jurisdictions; we'll DM if needed.
people-ops: we'll add a pre-payroll data sync check to the relocation checklist so HRIS -> Payroll tax flags are confirmed before any variable comp runs. :white_check_mark:
dan.pay: closing loop: will post confirmation once credit posts and corrected payslip is live in Self-Service. payroll-bot: PR-5301 status changed to In Progress by dan.pay at 1746023500.
